changes: Selected raster metadata reports image count and whether total plays is0 or greater than1
Repeating animations use lazy cyclic index order; pages/mips and one-play animations keep linear order
Configured ahead/behind direction bias and primary-side ordering retained
Opposite range clipped algebraically to avoid duplicates/current frame without a visited set
Direction inference uses circular distances for repeating animations: last->first forward, first->last backward
All offset arithmetic avoids selected+offset overflow; invalid/empty/single selections produce empty plans
limits: Finite repeats use global source play count; speculative wrapping may warm an unused first frame during the final pass
Circular shortest-distance inference for nonadjacent seeks is a policy heuristic; equal distances choose forward
Real cache control uses4-entry RAM capacity; smaller configured limits may refuse speculative admission as intended
Lazy usizeMAX tests inspect bounded prefixes, not impossible full-collection allocation
No wall-clock speed/FPS, new GPU/physical HDR/NVIDIA or complete100-format qualification
